privacy.title: Privacy, in plain language.
privacy.body:
Last updated: October 15, 2026.

What passes through Pocket

When you resolve a link, the server sends its canonical Instagram URL to Instagram using public-access methods. Metadata and CDN links are kept in a short-lived memory cache (10 minutes by default). Download tokens also have a short lifetime (10 minutes by default). Expired records are removed on resolution requests or by a cleanup sweep that runs approximately every 15 seconds; all in-memory records disappear when the server restarts.

Files and audio

The server fetches and transmits media to your device. It does not maintain a permanent media library, but files do pass through server memory and network infrastructure. If MP3 conversion is available, a temporary video and audio file are created on the server and removed after the request completes or fails. Abnormal server shutdown may require system temporary-file cleanup.

No tracking library

Pocket has no analytics trackers, advertising cookies or user accounts. Aggregate operational metrics record method success and failure, not your pasted links. The network address observed by the server is held in memory for abuse protection. Rate-limit entries are normally removed after about one hour without a recorded request, on a periodic cleanup sweep; the observed address may belong to a proxy depending on deployment configuration. Deployment providers may process IP addresses and infrastructure logs under their own policies.

Your device, your choice

Theme preference is stored in your browser. Recent links are stored locally only if you enable history. Turning it off or selecting “Clear local history” removes those entries. The installable app caches only the public interface, not resolved media or API responses.

No third-party API sharing by default

No aggregator API is configured. Public URLs are requested from Instagram and its media CDNs. If an operator adds another provider, this policy must be updated before enabling it.

terms.title: A little common sense.
terms.body:
Last updated: October 15, 2026.

Download thoughtfully

Only download content you own, have permission to use, or are legally entitled to use. Copyright exceptions, including fair dealing or fair use where applicable, are limited and depend on the jurisdiction and circumstances. Public visibility, personal use, attribution or a non-commercial purpose does not by itself establish permission for every download. Downloading does not transfer copyright or grant permission to republish. Respect creators, attribution, privacy and applicable platform terms.

Public doesn’t mean unrestricted

Pocket accesses publicly available content only. It does not provide Instagram accounts, bypass private access, solve security challenges or grant access to deleted or expired posts. Do not use it for harassment, surveillance, unlawful collection or infringement.

Platform permission and content rights

Access to publicly visible media is not a statement that Instagram authorizes automated access. Instagram restricts automated access and collection in its terms. A creator’s permission does not necessarily authorize access to Instagram’s systems or cover music and other third-party material in a post. The operator must independently establish the necessary permissions and legal basis.

A free utility, not a guarantee

Instagram can change or limit public access at any time. Files, quality options and availability are provided as available, without a guarantee of uptime or completeness. Technical rate limits, concurrency and file-size safeguards protect the service. There is no paid tier or daily download quota.

Independent by design

Pocket is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Instagram or Meta. Instagram trademarks belong to their respective owners. Files are fetched and transmitted through the server to the requesting user. No permanent media library or public feed is maintained. This technical design does not itself grant copyright permission or establish a legal exemption.

Operating this service

Before a public launch, the operator must add their legal entity, contact and rights-request process, review local law and hosting requirements, and configure an appropriate retention policy. These baseline terms are not legal advice.
